Six Front Windows
Windows · 2155 Elm Tree Rd
Six Front Windows, Pocket-Fit Replacement

We measured the six double-hung windows across the front of your home, all on the second floor. Every one of them is being quoted as a pocket-fit replacement, which means the new window is built to fit inside your existing window frame. Your interior casing and exterior trim stay in place, so there's far less disruption to the walls and siding around each opening.

Remove the existing sashes, tracks and hardware at all six openings
Set, shim, fasten and insulate a new double-hung window in each existing frame
Reinstall or replace the interior stops and seal the exterior
Take down and rehang your blinds and shades at each window
Haul away the old sashes and all job debris

Option A · Pella 250 Series
Option A
Pella 250 Series, Vinyl

The first option is the Pella 250 Series, a vinyl double-hung window. The frame and sashes are solid white vinyl inside and out, so there's nothing to paint or refinish down the road. This is typically the more budget-friendly of the two options.

White vinyl frame and sash, interior and exterior
No painting or staining of the window itself, now or later
Same double-hung operation you have today

Option B · Pella Lifestyle
Option B
Pella Lifestyle Series

The second option is the Pella Lifestyle Series. It's a wood window with an aluminum-clad exterior, so you keep the look and feel of a real wood window on the inside with a low-maintenance finish on the outside. The interior comes factory finished in white.

Wood window with an aluminum-clad exterior
White interior and white exterior from the factory
The closer match to the wood windows your home has now

Interior Trim
Finishing
Interior Trim Painted White to Match

Your existing window trim is stained wood, and the new windows will be white inside. So the two look right together, we're including the trim around each of the six windows being painted white to match the new window.

Stools (the interior sill) painted white

Casing around each window painted white

What Happens Next
Next Steps
Here's Where We Go From Here

Nothing more is needed from you right now. Here's the process from here.

1
We send your window schedule out for pricing on both options, Pella 250 Series vinyl and Pella Lifestyle.
2
You receive a written estimate showing both options side by side, including the trim painting.
3
The Village of Elm Grove requires a building permit for window replacement, so that will be accounted for in your estimate.
4
Once you pick an option, we confirm final measurements, place the order, and schedule your installation for when the windows arrive.
5
If you'd like to change anything before we price it, such as the grid pattern, colors or hardware finish, just let us know.
